CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS planned_at) scheduled_at CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS ready_at) dependency_ready CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tr.parent_workflow_run_id IS NOT NULL AND ji.params_snapshot #>> '{effectiveParams,_parentNodeRunId}' ~ '^[0-9]+$' AS enabled ) workflow_child CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS reference_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(reference.value ->> 'effectiveAt', 'timestamp with time zone') THEN 1 END) AS valid_reference_count, MAX(CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(reference.value ->> 'effectiveAt', 'timestamp with time zone') THEN (reference.value ->> 'effectiveAt')::timestamptz END) AS ready_at FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN workflow_child.enabled AND jsonb_typeof(ji.params_snapshot -> 'dependencyResultSnapshot') = 'array' THEN ji.params_snapshot -> 'dependencyResultSnapshot' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) reference ) captured_dependencies CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN workflow_child.enabled THEN CASE WHEN (jsonb_exists(ji.params_snapshot, 'dependencyResultSnapshot') AND jsonb_typeof(ji.params_snapshot -> 'dependencyResultSnapshot') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array') OR captured_dependencies.reference_count != captured_dependencies.valid_reference_count THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(tr.created_at, captured_dependencies.ready_at) END WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NOT NULL AND dependency_ready.ready_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(scheduled_at.planned_at, dependency_ready.ready_at), dependency_ready.ready_at) WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NULL AND jd.schedule_type = 'CRON' THEN scheduled_at.planned_at ELSE NULL END AS eligible_at ) eligibility
